git-lab-server.name: Git lab server (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
git-lab-server.notes: The one machine of the git-lab (vms/labs/git-lab/): git and git-flow, and a repository prepared by the post-install (vms/labs/git-lab/provision/setup-git-lab.sh) for the lab user: ~/workspace with real branches (feature/hello merged, feature/conflict with a resolved conflict, feature/stash rebased onto a hotfix, develop with a finished git-flow feature and the release 1.0 tagged v1.0) and a bare remote at /srv/git/lab.git. The exercises change history; ~/reset-git-lab.sh rebuilds everything. Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image. Ported from qlab's git-lab.

post_install_run: cd ~/workspace && git log --oneline main | wc -l | grep -qvE '^[0-5]$'
